errors.evidence: The description is too generic, stating the chart shows "the change in the value of some indicator over time". The reference description specifies that the chart illustrates the GDP per capita in Slovakia from 2012 to 2019, which is crucial context.
The word "Царгитаните" is not a correct Bulgarian word and its meaning is unclear. The context suggests it might mean "ticks" or "labels", but as written, it impairs readability.
The description claims the Y-axis is labeled with "coins" ("монети"). The Y-axis has no label or units shown in the figure. This is an unsupported interpretation.
The description states the line increases to 23500 in 2019. The chart shows the final value in 2019 is approximately 22900, which is significantly lower than 23500 (the top of the axis range).

errors.text_span: Чуква се надолу до около 21600 през 2015 г.
errors.evidence: This description is incorrect in several ways: 1) The line has a peak in 2015, not a dip. 2) The dip actually occurs in 2016. 3) The peak value in 2015 is approximately 21500, not 21600. The description misidentifies the event, its timing, and its value.
